messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: cluster-prod-gpu-5 high OOM rate on serving-runtime (kv-cache / paged-attn allocator). 12 containers OOM in 7m, autorestart bounced containers. Incident severity: Sev2. Link: https://alerts.redwood.example/INC-1799013579 :rotating_light:

alice: I'm on it — pulling logs and node metrics now. tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre.

infra-bot: Auto-evict sweep started (policy=aggressive-eject, target=best-effort). Nodes targeted: gpu-5b,gpu-5c. Started by oncall-bot.

dmitri: Seeing repeated errors in runtime logs:

```
[2026-07-12T02:12:41Z] runtime: request=gen-embed id=abc123 pid=5421 ERROR cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-07-12T02:12:41Z] runtime: kv_page_alloc: unable to reserve pages -> fragmentation high (free_segments=18, free_bytes=48MB)
[2026-07-12T02:12:42Z] runtime: falling back to slab_alloc -> may increase resident set
[2026-07-12T02:12:45Z] runtime: process 5421 killed by OOM (OOM score 100)
```

Also paged-attn stats from gpu-5b: total_kv_pages=16384 used=15290 (93.4%), free_segments=19, compaction_cycles=2 in last 1h (expected ~20). This smells like compaction/eviction frequency regression.

carla: Are customers affected? we need impact numbers for CS.

ben: Yes — routing shows increased latency on /v1/embeddings (us-west-2). 5xx spike to 4.5% (baseline 0.3%). A handful of clients report aborted connections. Pagerduty already noisy.

alice: Quick mitigations I'm executing:
- rolling back PR 4872 (evict timer change) to canary pool
- increasing eviction aggressiveness on affected nodes
- request scale-up of +3 gpus as fallback

```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/serving-runtime --to-revision=1234
kubectl patch cm serving-runtime-config -p '{"data":{"kv.evict.threshold":"0.68"}}'
```

infra-bot: Scale-up requested: +3 g4dn nodes provisioning (eta ~4m). Evict-sweep on gpu-5b in progress.

dmitri: I'll run a manual kv compaction on gpu-5b once the canary rollback completes. Command: `/opt/redwood/bin/kv_compact --target /dev/nvme0n1 --force` (will cause ~30s per process restart). Doing dry-run first:

```
/opt/redwood/bin/kv_compact --target /dev/nvme0n1 --dry-run
```

carla: Preparing CS note and NOC broadcast. Drafting timeline for customers impacted (will attach sample metrics).

ben: We currently have 7 paying customers with >10% error rate on embedding route (ids redacted). I'm throttling best-effort traffic for non-enterprise tenants to reduce pressure.

sre-lead: If rollback + compaction doesn't stabilize in 10m, prepare to fail traffic to Dedicated-us-west-2 pools and consider partial regional failover. Also create incident ticket ENGOPS-2026 and assign postmortem owners.

alice: Rollback completed on canary (10:22Z). Monitoring canary metrics now.

infra-bot: Canary metrics: OOM restarts/min pre-rollback=2.3, post-rollback=0.9 (10m window). Evict sweep freed some allocs on gpu-5c.

dmitri: Starting compaction on gpu-5b (non-dry run). Output snippet: 

```
kv_compact: scanned 16384 pages, merged 420 segments, freed 1.87 GiB, slab_fragmentation down 12%
kv_compact: restarting runtime process pid=5421 -> restart ok
```

dmitri: Observed immediate reduction in CUDA OOMs on that node. Still seeing a handful of OOMs on gpu-5d where compaction hasn't run.

carla: CS update sent to impacted customers; no escalations to SEV1. We included mitigation ETA and next update at +30m.

ben: I've widened eviction threshold cluster-wide to 0.68 for 30m and lowered batch token limits per-request to reduce peak allocation spikes.

dmitri: Root-cause hypothesis: recent change (PR 4872) reduced compaction frequency and changed eviction heuristics — allowed logged-in long-sequence workloads to create many small free segments, increasing fragmentation and GPU resident pressure until CUDA OOMs. We'll revert change, add unit/regression test for compaction frequency, and add metric alerts for compaction_cycles < 5/h.

sre-lead: Assignments: runtime owner=dmitri, infra owner=alice, customer comms=ben, postmortem owners=dmitri+carla. Incident ID INC-1799013579. Handoff to next on-call in ~2h. Please leave notes in the incident ticket.

alice: Acknowledged. I've added a short runbook entry in /ops/runbooks/paged-alloc and pinned the canary dashboard.

infra-bot: Cluster scale up completed (+3 nodes). New capacity added to autoscaler.

carla: Metrics look stable — error rate back down to 0.4%, latency returned to baseline for most customers. We'll watch for 1h before closing incident.

ben: Keeping throttles for 30m, CS will send follow-up if anything changes.

dmitri: I'll open PR to revert the evict-timer change + add tests. Will add a canary job to run compaction simulation nightly.

sre-lead: Good work. Postmortem template assigned, please include timeline, root cause, mitigation steps, test to prevent recurrence, and customer impact summary.

alice: Handoff: leaving this in the next oncall's queue with notes. all clear for now.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT INC-1799013579 status: monitoring. next update scheduled in 30m.
